title: Behavioural feature vector (full call or live prefix)
description: null = not observable (e.g. no timestamps), which is different from 0. Generated from vani_persona.features.registry.

n_seller_turns.description: [context/turn_taking, reliability=high] Number of seller turns observed so far.

seller_mean_tokens.description: [detail/communication_preference, reliability=medium] Mean whitespace tokens per seller turn.

short_reply_ratio.description: [segment/turn_taking, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns with at most 3 tokens.

long_reply_ratio.description: [detail/engagement, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns with at least 15 tokens.

question_rate.description: [segment/engagement, reliability=low] Share of seller turns that ask something ('?' or a question word).

clarification_rate.description: [detail/communication_preference, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns asking to repeat or clarify.

brevity_request_rate.description: [detail/communication_preference, reliability=high] Share of seller turns explicitly asking VANI to be brief.

time_pressure_rate.description: [detail/engagement, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns stating they are busy / want a later call.

objection_price_rate.description: [detail/objection, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns raising cost/fees.

objection_trust_rate.description: [detail/objection, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns questioning legitimacy (spam/fraud/who is calling).

objection_not_interested_rate.description: [detail/objection, reliability=high] Share of seller turns stating disinterest.

objection_already_have_rate.description: [detail/objection, reliability=low] Share of seller turns saying it is already done/available.

info_request_rate.description: [detail/objection, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns asking for details to be sent (WhatsApp/email).

affirmation_rate.description: [segment/conversation_progression, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns containing an affirmation (haan/ji/ok/theek hai).

engagement_slope.description: [detail/conversation_progression, reliability=low] Linear slope of seller tokens per turn over seller turn order (tokens/turn).

response_latency_median_ms.description: [detail/speaking_pace, reliability=medium] Median gap between the end of an agent turn and the start of the next seller turn.

overlap_rate.description: [detail/turn_taking, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns that start before the preceding agent turn ended (or agent turns flagged interrupted when timestamps are absent).

log_mean_tokens.description: [segment/communication_preference, reliability=medium] log(1 + mean tokens per seller turn): verbosity on a scale robust to a few long monologues.

resistance_rate.description: [segment/objection, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns raising ANY objection (price, trust, not interested, already have).

rush_rate.description: [segment/engagement, reliability=medium] Share of seller turns signalling time pressure or asking VANI to be brief.

devanagari_ratio.description: [language/language, reliability=high] Share of seller letters in Devanagari script.

hindi_function_ratio.description: [language/language, reliability=medium] Hindi function words / (Hindi + English function words) in seller speech.

code_switch_rate.description: [language/language, reliability=low] Share of seller turns containing both Hindi and English function words.
